actual: The canonical synchronizer recognizes Common statements by explicit resource paths and one cpf-common target, while check-query-contract-integrity always searches vendor runtime/<module>/repository and only discovers .required("key") calls. It reports three missing repositories, 14 missing consumers, and one retired Education sample scope for Common.
rootCause: F186 added portable-resource synchronization without currentizing the independent integrity gate's source-consumer and resource-location model.
repair: The independent gate now validates explicit resource inventory, CpfCommonSqlResourceLoader literal paths, parameters and the single generated target without DB3 duplication or exemptions. The nonexistent Education sample scope was removed.
